summary: Pre-launch production audit for Sunnah Umrah PWA (Capacitor iOS/Android build Sunday). Backend: 9/9 pytest regression tests pass (chat, gates, group, progress); Sadaqah routes are disabled by design (Navigate to / in App.js per Apple Guideline 3.2.1(vii)/4.5.4) so those tests were deselected. Frontend: All 17 secondary pages have working ← Back buttons that return to Home; the 5 new data-testids (chat-back, group-back, qibla-back, ramadan-back, shop-back) are present and functional. Arabic-mode QuickTile bug FIX VERIFIED — on Home the 6 tiles (Stay together/Ask/Qibla/I'm lost/Ziyārah/Quiz) correctly render ARABIC labels (ابقَ معًا/اسأل/القبلة/أنا تائه/الزّيارة/الاختبار) with zero English leak, and /plan Tags correctly show فنادق/رحلات/شريحة with zero English leak. Home renders all core sections (hero greeting, tour CTA, prayer times live from Aladhan, 2x3 quick-tile grid, travel-and-more, footer). /chat sends a real question and receives a Claude Sonnet 4.5 answer grounded in Sunnah (verified via UI and via direct curl). /group create-group flow works (6-char code returned). /quiz renders all categories/difficulties with quiz-start, quiz-option-0..3, and quiz-next testids. /shop renders 6 external affiliate Buy/Browse links. /qibla shows location-permission prompt when geolocation is denied (expected in test env). /ramadan shows the 'upcoming' countdown state correctly (today is Feb 2026). /places lists ziyarah places with working PlaceDetail routing. Zero console errors on initial load. Service worker umrah-v1.35.0 is NOT registered in the preview env because index.js gates registration on NODE_ENV=='production' — preview runs CRA dev build, so this is expected; the SW WILL register in the production Capacitor/PWA build.

issues: Minor: When navigating between pages in Arabic mode, some content briefly appears horizontally shifted on the right edge (cosmetic only; text remains readable and scrollable). Not a blocker.

action_items: No launch blockers found. App is ready for Capacitor iOS/Android build on Sunday.

(Optional, post-launch) If PWA install is desired from the preview domain itself, remove the NODE_ENV==='production' gate in /app/frontend/src/index.js line 15 OR ensure the preview env serves a production build so SW registers and the app is installable. For Capacitor native, this is irrelevant.
(Optional) Set STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET in backend/.env before re-enabling /sadaqah routes in the future.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js correctly redirects /sadaqah and /sadaqah/success to / via <Navigate replace> — this is the right way to preserve old bookmarks while disabling the flow for Apple review.

Home.jsx QuickTile now uses `isAr ? ar : en` props — the previous lang-en/lang-ar CSS-class approach has been fully removed, so toggling language is instantaneous and deterministic. Plan.jsx Tag component follows the same pattern. Good.

All back-button implementations are consistent: <Link to='/'> with the same class string and ← icon + 'Back'/'الرّجوع'. Consider extracting a <BackLink isAr label testid/> component to avoid the ~18 duplicated JSX blocks across pages (minor DRY improvement, not a bug).

Ramadan.jsx has the back button duplicated in all 3 return branches (upcoming/during/past) — same data-testid='ramadan-back' is reused, which is fine since only one branch renders at a time, but the duplication increases file size; could be hoisted above the switch.
server.py is ~470 lines and growing — once Sadaqah is re-enabled, consider splitting into routes/chat.py, routes/group.py, routes/gates.py, routes/sadaqah.py.
index.js gates SW registration on NODE_ENV='production' — correct for CRA, but worth documenting in README so future devs know the preview env will not cache offline.
No console errors observed on any of the 17 pages audited.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 regression tests pass; Sadaqah tests deselected by design)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 17 secondary pages have working back buttons; Arabic fix verified on both Home and Plan; Chat, Group, Quiz, Shop, Places, Ramadan, Qibla flows all verified)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 chat session (TEST_sess_audit) and 1 group record during testing. Safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -k 'not sadaqah' — 9 tests should pass. The /sadaqah routes are currently redirected to / in App.js (lines 57-58) per Apple App Store policy; do NOT re-enable without re-reading iteration_3.json. Preview env does NOT register service worker (NODE_ENV=dev); production build will. Onboarding sheet (data-testid='onboard-overlay') appears on first visit and intercepts clicks — remove it from DOM or set localStorage keys ['umrah_onboard_seen','umrah_onboarded'] before UI tests. data-testids for back buttons: chat-back, group-back, qibla-back, ramadan-back, shop-back (new), plus pre-existing on all other secondary pages. Language toggle: [data-testid='lang-toggle']; html[dir] flips between ltr/rtl.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — this is a pre-launch audit run, not a bug investigation. All reported bugs from the user request (missing back buttons on Shop/Ask/Qibla, Arabic-mode QuickTile English leak) were verified as fixed.
